entries.what: Linh wakes at 6:45 and gets through Monday anatomy with Dr. Okoye on an empty stomach, then bikes to Heron & Grind for her noon shift.
entries.outcome: Class done, but she skipped breakfast and lunch again.

entries.what: Pulling shots at Heron & Grind, Linh goes gray and nearly faints at the espresso bar; Jun sits her down with a banana and Wes teases her.
entries.outcome: Jun makes her sit and eat; Beatrice lets her take a break.

entries.what: On break she asks the assistant for quick lunch ideas she can pack, and settles on Sunday-prepped rice bowls.
entries.outcome: Decides to make a rice bowl plan and starts packing lunch from now on.

entries.what: Closes out the shift, then eats the plate Hạnh left her at home and plans the week in her paper planner.
entries.outcome: Planner filled in with meal prep on Sunday.

entries.what: Tuesday: General Chemistry at 11, with a ride from Kenji in his dented hatchback.
entries.outcome: Solid notes; she ate her packed rice bowl at noon.

entries.what: Skips Pedro's 4 p.m. anatomy group at the library and studies alone with her color-coded notes.
entries.outcome: Got through the muscle chapter solo.

entries.what: Evening review of her 600-card anatomy deck while lo-fi plays.
entries.outcome: Bed by 12:30.

entries.what: Wednesday anatomy at 9, then a noon shift at Heron & Grind.
entries.outcome: Busy lunch rush, no near-faint this time.

entries.what: Between customers Linh highlights a yellow list of structures likely on the practical, and Wes calls her Doc.
entries.outcome: Yellow list is two pages long.

entries.what: Home dinner at 8 with Hạnh, who asks about pharmacy classes; Linh gives short answers.
entries.outcome: Pharmacy talk postponed again.

entries.what: Thursday chemistry at 11 with a Kenji ride; lunch is her packed rice bowl.
entries.outcome: Finished the problem set early.

entries.what: Walks her bike's replacement problem through: she is taking the shuttle bus after her lock replacement and the library theft.
entries.outcome: Shuttle gets her to campus on time.

entries.what: Evening at the library with her notes on the nervous system; pours a pour-over at home after.
entries.outcome: Green nerve notes finished.

entries.what: Friday anatomy at 9; Dr. Okoye posts grades and Linh sees she is sitting at a B+.
entries.outcome: B+ going into the first practical.

entries.what: Over lunch Linh asks the assistant what percentile a B+ would be in a section where a third fail the practicals, and whether she's doing okay.
entries.outcome: Gets a rough sense but keeps wondering how others are doing.

entries.what: Evening shift swap texts with Sam about Saturday; Linh quietly agrees to cover again.
entries.outcome: Another swap on the books.

entries.what: Saturday 6:30 opening at Heron & Grind, covering part of Sam's shifts.
entries.outcome: Sam now owes Linh two Saturday shifts.

entries.what: Jun sells lumpia at the counter on Saturday under Beatrice's deal; Linh bags orders.
entries.outcome: Sold out by 11.

entries.what: Afternoon studying the skeleton with blue notes, followed by phở leftovers at home.
entries.outcome: Bones chapter reviewed.

entries.what: Sunday shift 6:30 to 1 at Heron & Grind, then Lotus Nails front desk 2 to 5.
entries.outcome: Long day but helped Hạnh.

entries.what: Walks the Ulloa marsh boardwalk, passing the farmers market crowd at Delgado Park on the way.
entries.outcome: Head cleared before the week.

entries.what: Preps rice bowls for the week and fills in her planner with washi tape.
entries.outcome: Five bowls packed.
